message.text: Locating the frontend source file where ConnectRPC service clients are created.

The ConnectRPC service clients are imported from `@/connect`.

The connect module is likely `web/src/connect.ts`.
Checking web/src/connect.ts to verify it creates the ConnectRPC service clients.
`web/src/connect.ts` contains all ConnectRPC service client creation via `createClient()`.
